behaviorRules: 100% behavioral equivalence: External behavior and API contracts must remain identical; zero sneaky feature changes.
Complexity & size reduction: Enforce CC <= 15, Depth <= 4, Noise <= 4.0; dissolve pass-through trampolines (facade-discipline).
Zero transient heap allocation: Eliminate implicit allocations on hot paths via reuse or fixed buffers.
Comment contract maintenance: Maintain 6-field JSDoc/Rustdoc contracts for refactored symbols.
RGB regression loop: Green tests before refactoring; verify regression at each step.
